title: Storage and cookies in extensions
notes: Frames under a chrome-extension:// page with host permissions use the site top-level partition; third-party cookies not blocked in subframes of an extension page.

title: Controlled Frame
notes: Controlled Frame is exclusively available within Isolated Web Apps.

title: Chrome Platform Status feature entry for Isolated Web Apps
notes: IWA install through admin policy on enterprise-managed ChromeOS only, as quoted by the isolation report.

title: IFrame credentialless
notes: A nonce is set once per top-level document.

title: Anonymous iframe specification
notes: Nonce shared by every credentialless iframe that descends from the same top-level document.

title: Fenced frames
notes: Fenced frames load only through ad-auction or shared-storage configs; scheduled for phase-out.

title: Storage partitioning
notes: Extensions embedding sites: embedded sites use their top-level partition when the extension has host permissions (embedding report item 13).
